provenance.quote: PEEP levels determined by the following strategies were studied: (1) plateau pressure 28–30 cmH2O (Express), (3) center of ventilation closest to 0.5 (CoV) and (4) intersection of the EIT-based overdistension and lung collapse curves (Crossing Point).

crossover_order.value: A single decremental PEEP trial from PEEP 20 to 5 cmH2O with steps of 3 cmH2O every 3 minutes; order not randomised

provenance.quote: PEEP level was increased at 20 cmH2O then was progressively decreased by steps of 3 cmH2O every 3 min, until PEEP reached 5 cmH2O.

washout_or_stabilisation.value: Each PEEP level was held for 3 minutes during the decremental trial; before the trial, PEEP 15 and 5 were held for 20 min each

provenance.quote: PEEP level of 15, then 5 cm H2O was applied for 20 min. At the end of each period, inspiratory and expiratory pauses were performed, and arterial blood gases were obtained.

subgroup_flags.classification_notes: All patients had ARDS per Berlin criteria. Median BMI 30.4 kg/m2, so obese population. Enrolled within 24h of ARDS diagnosis, so early. The esophageal-guided strategy used absolute end-expiratory transpulmonary pressure (PLe) between 0 and 2 cmH2O.

extraction_flags.overlap_evidence: Suspected overlap based on same centre (Angers University Hospital) and shared authorship. The current report does not include a comparison of enrolment dates or trial registration with chean_2025 because that report was not available for extraction. Pavlovsky 2024 also states that 10 COVID-19 ARDS patients were previously published in Beloncle 2020, which is not in the current review pool. So overlap with chean_2025 is unconfirmed.
unclear_items: Table 2 PEEPtot for Positive PLe is reported as 7 [10–14], which has an IQR lower bound (10) greater than the median (7) and is inconsistent with the abstract value of 8 [5–11]. Recorded as reported.

Table 2 PEEPtot for Express is reported as 18 [16–19], but the abstract reports 17 [14–17]. The decremental PEEP steps are 20, 17, 14, 11, 8, 5, so 18 is not a possible PEEP step. This inconsistency is unresolved.
Respiratory rate in Table 1 is reported as 30 [24–29] which is impossible (IQR lower bound greater than median). Recorded as reported.
Age, SAPS II, etc. are from Table 1; we assume all 19 patients contributed to all baseline values except where noted.

n_analysed is set to 19 for all arms, but esophageal pressure data were missing for one patient, so outcomes involving esophageal pressure (e.g., PLe, PLi) likely have n=18. This is not specified in the paper.
Arms: we added a 'cohort' arm to allow recording of the cohort-level 28-day mortality outcome, which is not specific to any crossover condition.
Blinding is not reported; assumed not blinded.
The study does not report a standard-care comparator arm; comparator_types are set to 'other' for the Express, CoV, and Crossing Point strategies.
extraction_flags.general_notes: Correlations between optimal PEEP and R/Iest: Crossing Point r2=0.073, p=0.263; CoV r2<0.001, p=0.941; Express r2<0.001, p=0.920; Positive PLe r2=0.037, p=0.461. Median ΔPaO2/FiO2 was 18.3 [−3.8–37.1] % and median ΔCRS was −5.6 [−31.9–14.9] % after PEEP increase from 5 to 15 cmH2O. No adverse event reported during the decremental PEEP trial.
